templates.pattern: [P1] starts from point A facing North. Walks [D1] km, turns left, walks [D2] km, turns left, walks [D3] km. What direction does [P1] face and how far is [P1] from A (East-West only)?
templates.explanation: North→left=West[D2]→left=South[D3]. Now facing South. East-West displacement = [D2] km West.

templates.pattern: [P1] and [P2] start from same point. [P1] walks [D1] km North then [D2] km East. [P2] walks [D2] km East then [D1] km North. How far apart are [P1] and [P2]?
templates.explanation: Both end at the same point (N[D1]+E[D2] = E[D2]+N[D1]). They are 0 km apart.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km towards North-East, then turns and walks [D1] km towards South-East. In which direction is [P1] from the starting point?
templates.explanation: NE gives equal North and East components. SE gives equal South and East components. North and South cancel. Net movement is East only.

templates.pattern: [P1] is facing South-West. Turns 90 degrees clockwise. Which direction does [P1] face now?

[P1] starts from O, walks [D1] km East to A, then [D2] km North to B, then [D1] km West to C, then [D2] km South back. [P2] starts from O and walks [D3] km directly to C. What direction does [P2] walk?
templates.explanation: [P1] returns to O (complete rectangle). C is at same latitude as O. [P2] walks from O directly — C is at E[D1],N[D2] then W[D1]=O horizontally, N[D2]. So C = North of O. [P2] walks North.

templates.pattern: [P1] faces North. Turns right 3 times. [P2] faces South. Turns left 3 times. Do they face the same direction?
templates.explanation: [P1]: N→E→S→W (3 right turns). [P2]: S→E→N→W (3 left turns). Both face West. Yes, same direction.

templates.pattern: A clock is placed on a wall. The minute hand points East at 3 o'clock position. Which direction does the hour hand point at 12 o'clock?
templates.explanation: 3 o'clock = East. 12 o'clock is 90° anticlockwise from 3. East rotated 90° anticlockwise = North.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km in the direction of South-West, then turns and walks [D1] km North-West. In which direction is [P1] from the starting point?
templates.explanation: SW has equal S and W components. NW has equal N and W components. S and N cancel. Net is West only. [P1] is to the West.

templates.pattern: [P1] stands at the centre of a square field with sides facing North, South, East, West. Walks to the North-East corner. What is the direction from the North-East corner back to the centre?
templates.explanation: From NE corner, the centre is in the South-West direction.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km North, turns 45 degrees right (North-East direction), walks [D2] km. Which general direction is [P1] from start?
templates.explanation: Walking North then North-East keeps [P1] in the North-East quadrant from start. Direction is North-East.

templates.pattern: [P1] takes 3 left turns starting from North. Each turn is 90°. Which direction does [P1] face finally?
templates.explanation: North → left(W) → left(S) → left(E). After 3 left turns = East.

templates.pattern: [P1] and [P2] face each other. [P1] faces North. [P2] turns 90 degrees to the right. Which direction does [P2] now face?
templates.explanation: [P1] faces North → [P2] faces South (opposite). [P2] turns right from South → West.
